tasks.description: Read-only local acceptance of the CI workflow candidate after controller-only check-argument repair. Validate configuration and actual portable fixture dependencies; cloud execution/T006 remains unverified.
constraints: This is a new READ-ONLY acceptance packet: no Developer and no file edits. The preceding run parallel-ios-fixture-ci-20261110-01 is preserved BLOCKED: simulator process exited0, but controller inferred a Doctor summary from a check_run_id token in its env-output path. Controller fixed ONLY that config argument in a separate config, using an explicit ephemeral path with no summary-protocol token. Do not change engine/helper or reinterpret the old FAIL as accepted. Inspect the existing workflow and helpers, run all configured real checks, then independent Reviewer/QA. No remote CI claim.

Write only the existing workflow. Do not edit app code, test/gate scripts, SQL/TS/KB/contracts, packages, config, handoff, tasks, AGENTS or Git. The controller prepares the small portable SQL dependency-path adapter before this run; it delegates unchanged business assertions to the accepted private PG17 gate. Accepted app/gates 546880a have 184 actual units and18actualENPLUI/42PNG/Release/Simulator verified; no iOS source or gate change is needed in this workflow packet.

Preserve push/main and pull_request/main triggers and ordinary cancellation of superseded runs; optional workflow_dispatch is fine. No cron, deployment, paid AI/model calls or live service credentials. Set only normal read access for repository contents. Do not use pull_request_target, add secrets, loosen network permissions, or run the model orchestrator from CI. The Deno test task already permits only loopback network; the iOS Doctor builds with blank live SDK settings and the explicit DEBUG fixtures isolate SDK/SQLite/HTTP.

Use verified official action commit pins: checkout 3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1(v7), setup-python 6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0(v7), upload-artifact cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9(v7), setup-deno 22d081ff2d3a40755e97629de92e3bcbfa7cf2ed(documented v2 branch). Those refs were resolved directly from public vendor repositories2026-11-10. Keep concise version comments. Deno2.9.8 is the actual locally tested version; Python tools require3.11+.

Deno job runs the336 existing fixture tests and frozen typecheck of the TWO actual entrypoints plants-api/index.ts and analysis-worker/index.ts. Existing deno.json task check incorrectly references missing billing-webhook/index.ts and maintenance/index.ts; do not invoke that stale alias, invent handlers, modify B-owned config or pretend those routes are tested. Record this limitation in your decisions for the controller handoff. The direct frozen typecheck of the two actual entrypoints passed locally.

SQL job uses private PostgreSQL17 and controller adapter tools/automation/parallel_ios_ci_sql_gate.py --pg-bin ACTUAL_PG17_BIN --pgtap-sql GENERATED_PGTAP_SQL. No live DB and no rewrites of business SQL/gates. Install the normal PG17 dependency if absent, using its actual installation prefix. Fetch official pgTAPv1.3.4 from theory/pgtap and verify peeled commit968eb53a33114e83042b3bdb0c664b5b80cf8bdf before building sql/pgtap.sql with that PG17 pg_config. The adapter invokes exactly accounting/legacyguard/cap-regression: clean/upgrade235assertions each, retained rows, real owner-lock races. Do not use stale shared t161 --slots equality gate or placeholders. Preserve raw SQL output and nonzero exit status.

iOS job uses a verified macOS26 runner and explicit /Applications/Xcode_26.3.app/Contents/Developer, matching local Xcode26.3 build17C529. Build the COMMITTED Xcode project and pinned packages via existing gates; do not add an unpinned XcodeGen regeneration dependency. Choose a truly available compatible iPhone17Pro simulator/runtime from actual xcrun simctl JSON (matching SDK major); never hardcode the local Simulator UUID. If creation is needed, create only an ephemeral CI device from actual available runtime/device-type identifiers. Pass the selected UUID explicitly to each gate. Keep one simulator and serial gate execution. The controller-owned parallel_ios_ci_simulator.py performs this selection: run it with --env-output "$GITHUB_ENV" and --create-if-needed only on the ephemeral cloud runner, then use NARAT_CI_SIMULATOR. Agents must not execute creation or workflow steps locally; the controller checks read-only selection separately.

The iOS job actually runs parallel_ios_sync_gate.py (build/welcome/all source unit methods, no skips), parallel_ios_catalogue_ui_gate.py (all18 real ENPL cases, screenshots, no skips or expected failures) and parallel_ios_catalogue_release_gate.py (actual Release/no fixture markers). All support --run-id and --simulator. Use unique short run IDs derived from the GitHub run ID/attempt, valid for existing Doctor rules. A build-for-testing step alone is insufficient. Existing UI tests themselves exercise both English and Polish; do not invent a language matrix that only compiles.

Use sensible bounded timeouts for fresh dependency/build/18UI work. Upload whitelisted fixture summaries/raw logs/PNG evidence on failure as well as success, with bounded retention and unique job/run/attempt artifact names. Do not upload credentials, auth settings, entire workspace, package caches, DerivedData or build binaries. Avoid masking check failures with pipelines or unconditional success. Quote task-specific shell variables; do not repurpose HOME or system settings.

Controller local checks cover real YAML and shell syntax, frozen API/worker typecheck,336Deno,123automation and actual portable private SQL adapter behavior. Reviewer/QA inspect the whole workflow and correspondence to accepted iOS gates/evidence. Do not run controller gates yourself. Local configuration acceptance is NOT proof the cloud runner worked. Remote GitHub account/CI logs are unverified: gh is absent and the suggested GitHub plugin was not connected; browser was logged out. Do not claim T006 complete, install/connect a plugin, change account permissions or dispatch a remote run yourself. Controller publishes ordinary code and verifies cloud execution once authorized account access exists.
